verdict.rationale: Termius is a terminal client, so customizing font, colors, and cursor appearance is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of themes, color schemes, font settings, or cursor styling. The cursor items (termius-docs-30, termius-docs-47) cover moving the cursor by gesture on mobile, not its appearance, so they earn no credit. One community user also reports being unable to find a way to add custom fonts.
